Hi! My name is <mark style="background-color: lightblue"><b>Antonio Rungo</b> </mark>. Nice to see you here! Let me explain a bit more about myself and how I got to where I am now. 


My interest is in using data as a tool to answer research questions and test hypotheses. Currently, I'm am working on HIV PMTCT project to eliminate Pediatric AIDS as Senior Strategic Information Advisor at <a href="https://www.m2m.org" target="_blank">mothers2mothers</a> - Department of Research and Strategic Information in <mark style="background-color: lightblue"><b>Mozambique,</b> </mark> with a background in <mark style="background-color: lightblue"><b>data science</b> </mark>.  


I graduated from the <a href="https://www.uhasselt.be/en" target="_blank">University of Hasselt</a> with a MS in <mark style="background-color: lightblue"><b>biostatistics</b> </mark> in 2013. Looking for more tangible and dynamic work I left the world of public sector and worked on international non-governmental organization as Database Manager; Senior Database Manager & Data Analyst and M&E advisor for nine years.


It took me a while to figure out that, although I liked doing data analysis, I loved the visualization of the analysis and insights. In my evenings and weekends I started teaching myself about the subject of data visualization and I also started creating personal projects, where I worked on designing & building dashboards and other data visualizations.

In 2014 I began working as a part-time lecture in biostatistics module at <a href="https://www.uem.mz/index.php/faculdades-e-escolas/faculdades/faculdade-de-medicina" target="_blank">Eduardo Mondlane University - Faculty of Medicine</a>, where I am teaching biostatistics module for master students in public health, together with my colleague <a href="https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Gerito_Augusto" target="_blank">Dr. Gerito</a>.

I am an <a href="https://www.r-project.org/" target="_blank">R</a> and <a href="https://www.python.org/" target="_blank">Python</a> enthusiast.
